D: Diana's quiet life in 1984 Washington is upended by a wishing stone and a man who wants everything.
P: Serve the mains when Diana and Barbara go out to dinner together.
S: Mini hot dogs in pastry and cheese-topped potato skins, served together on a tray like the food court.
the island of Themyscira and its games
Green and black olives marinated with feta, lemon peel, oregano and olive oil, served with warm pita.
the car chase across the Egyptian desert
Chickpeas blitzed with onion, garlic, parsley and cumin, shaped and fried at 180C, with tahini sauce.
M: the two of them out for dinner and drinks
Chicken breasts stuffed with spinach and ricotta, seared and roasted at 200C for 20 minutes, with a lemon butter sauce and rice pilaf.
Pork ribs glazed with barbecue sauce, potato salad and corn on the cob for a holiday picnic.
W: Big soft cinnamon scrolls dripping with cream cheese icing, straight from the food court. Roll 500g sweet bread dough into a rectangle, spread with 80g soft butter mixed with 100g brown sugar and 2 tsp cinnamon, roll up and cut 8 scrolls.
K: the wishing stone that grants everyone's wish
Sparkling wine or sparkling grape juice with a sugar cube and a dash of orange bitters.

s.how: Wrap 16 cocktail franks in strips of puff pastry and bake at 200C for 15 minutes. Bake 6 small potatoes (about 800g) until soft, halve, scoop out a little and fill with cheddar and crisp bacon. Grill until bubbling and serve both with sour cream.

s.note: the island of Themyscira and its games
s.how: Toss 150g green olives, 150g kalamata olives and 200g cubed feta with strips of lemon peel, a teaspoon of oregano and olive oil. Leave to marinate for an hour. Serve in a shallow bowl with warm pita torn into pieces.

m.how: Rub 1.5kg pork ribs with salt and bake covered at 150C for 2.5 hours. Brush with barbecue sauce and grill until sticky. Boil 1kg potatoes, cool and dress with mayonnaise and spring onion. Grill 4 corn cobs and serve it all picnic style.

w.how: Roll 500g sweet bread dough into a rectangle, spread with 80g soft butter mixed with 100g brown sugar and 2 tsp cinnamon, roll up and cut 8 scrolls. Prove 30 minutes and bake at 180C for 25 minutes. Ice with 100g cream cheese beaten with 120g icing sugar.

d.note: the wishing stone that grants everyone's wish
d.how: Drop a sugar cube into each flute and add a dash of orange bitters. Pour sparkling wine for the grown-ups or sparkling grape juice for everyone else, so the bubbles stream up from the cube. Be careful what you wish for.
